# Veda Ravnby

Veda Ravnby is currently the Scheduling Coordinator at Vorrel Cloud, a company specializing in automating insurance claim submissions and providing real-time monitoring of approval statuses. Since joining Vorrel Cloud in 2021, Veda has become a key contributor to the clinic scheduling and billing domain, focusing on improving chair utilization through dynamic patient flow analysis.

Before joining Vorrel Cloud, Veda spent five years (2016–2021) working at Brightsmile Dental Services, where she honed her expertise in optimizing appointment scheduling to maximize operational efficiency. During her tenure there, she led the "Recall Boost" project, a targeted recall campaign that increased patient retention rates by 15% over 12 months. This initiative combined data-driven patient segmentation with personalized outreach strategies, significantly reducing no-show rates and enhancing long-term patient engagement.

Veda’s specialty lies in leveraging data analytics to balance patient demand with resource availability, ensuring that dental chairs are used effectively throughout the day while minimizing downtime. She integrates scheduling software insights with real-time clinic capacity, enabling dynamic adjustments that accommodate last-minute cancellations or emergency appointments. Her approach has consistently contributed to improved daily chair utilization rates, often exceeding 85%, a key performance metric for dental clinics aiming to maximize revenue and patient access.

A methodical yet adaptable planner, Veda prefers working collaboratively with clinical staff and billing teams. At Vorrel Cloud, she regularly coordinates with the Insurance Claims Operations group to synchronize patient appointment schedules with insurance authorization timelines, reducing billing delays. She also partners closely with the Recall Campaigns team, sharing insights from patient flow data to optimize outreach timing and content.

Veda’s working style combines analytical rigor with empathetic communication, allowing her to navigate the complex interplay of patient needs, clinical capacity, and insurance requirements. Her contributions continue to support Vorrel Cloud’s mission to streamline dental clinic workflows and enhance financial performance through smarter scheduling and billing automation.
